flags.headline: AEM — persisting RED: Barnat pit wall movement suspends mining at Canadian Malartic, 60-80koz H2 guidance cut
flags.detail: No new information since Friday's read (no trading session since). A rock-mass movement occurred 2026-07-01 along the north wall of the Barnat open pit at Canadian Malartic, Quebec — no injuries, no equipment damage, no environmental impact, but mining at the Barnat pit remains suspended as a precaution. Agnico Eagle expects H2 2026 Canadian Malartic production reduced by ~60,000-80,000 oz gold, pushing FY2026 guidance toward the low end of the 3.3-3.5M oz range. Updated guidance will be confirmed with Q2 2026 results on 2026-07-29.
